rows.name:
My skin's all rough today.
I must have not had enough
sleep. What do you think?

rows.label: tlk70000010_01_msg0002
rows.name:
Human bodies are inconvenient. Why
can't we have beauty gear that makes
you healthy just by equipping it?

rows.label: tlk70000010_01_msg0003
rows.name:
Drivers can give themselves
a boost with accessories,
Blades with Assist Cores, right?

rows.label: tlk70000010_01_msg0004
rows.name:
They all have their own particular
effects. Like some are restorative,
some are offensive, some defensive.

rows.label: tlk70000010_01_msg0005
rows.name:
Iira is behind the times. For beauty
devices, Invidia is the place to be
right now!

rows.label: tlk70000010_01_msg0006
rows.name:
I hear they have technology that works
directly on cells to make skin plump.
I'd love to try it someday.
